 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anil Kumar Upman
Order 01/04/2026

The instant Criminal Misc. Petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed
on behalf of the petitioner for quashing of Fir No.154/2022 registered at Police Station Pur, District
Bhilwara for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467 & 468 of Ipc.
Learned State Counsel has placed the factual report dated 30.03.2026 received from SHO, Police Station Pur, District Bhilwara.
The said report is taken on record.

According to the factual report,
investigation has already been completed and charge-sheet is ready to be filed in the concerned Court.
Learned State Counsel submits that in view of the investigation conducted so far, arrest of the petitioner is not required and charge-sheet may be submitted without making her arrest.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel appearing for the complainant/respondent No.2 does not dispute the aforesaid factual aspect and submits that this petition may be disposed of in terms of the submission made by the learned State Counsel.

Learned counsel for the petitioner also does not dispute the aforesaid aspect and submits that if investigating agency wants to file the charge-sheet without making arrest of the petitioner, then he has no objection to dispose of this petition.

In view of above, the present Criminal Misc. Petition is disposed of with the following terms:-
1. That learned State Counsel is directed to instruct the Investigating Officer of this case to submit the result of investigation before the concerned Trial Court within a period of two weeks from today.
2. That the Investigating Officer shall serve a notice upon the petitioner before filing of the charge- sheet.
3. That It is also made clear that till filing of the charge-sheet, no arrest of the petitioner shall be made in this case.
If petitioner fails to appear before the trial Court on the date of submission of charge-sheet, trial Court shall take appropriate steps in order to ensure the presence of the petitioner.
Stay application and pending application(s), if any, also stand dismissed.
